profiles.max_sub: The best picture this device can show.

home.screens_as_is: The computer's own displays, as they are
home.screen_match: {width} × {height} display at {refresh} Hz, sized for this screen
home.welcome_lead: The computer running KyberNow Station shows up on its own if it is on the same network. Otherwise, paste the pairing link from KyberNow Admin or type its address.

add.title: Add a computer
add.aside: Admin's QR code carries this same pairing link. Paste it here, or click it on this PC: KyberNow Link opens straight to adding the computer.
add.none_found: No computer announced yet. A computer running KyberNow Station announces itself on the local network; remotely (VPN), use the pairing link or the address.
add.compare: Compare the first four groups with the fingerprint shown in Admin, under Link devices. If it differs, stop here.
add.step1_after: , or the panel of its tray icon.
add.step3: Nothing else to type: this PC gets its own access, which you can remove from Admin.
add.account_hint: The computer's account (the one chosen at installation, or a device account). The password is stored in the Windows Credential Manager.

settings.custom_when: As soon as a setting differs from the profile.
settings.refresh_help: Match this display: this display's resolution and refresh rate. 4K at most: brought down to 3840 × 2160 if this display is larger.
settings.custom_help: The computer's virtual display takes this size, whether the picture is larger or smaller than this display (it is scaled). Up to 7680 × 4320 (4096 wide in H.264, reduced if needed).
settings.virtual_help: The computer creates a display sized for this device during the session; its own displays switch off, then come back at the end.
settings.sharp_text_help: Full colour: text stays sharp, at the cost of a higher bitrate.
settings.wifi_warn: Above 300 Mbit/s, Wi-Fi networks often drop out.
settings.display_help: “Synced” shows each frame at the display's next refresh, without tearing. “Immediate” shows it as soon as it is decoded: a fraction of a millisecond less, with possible tearing; a G-SYNC or FreeSync display then keeps pace with the frames.
settings.keep_help: The last image of your session becomes this computer's background on the home screen, kept on this PC only.
settings.sound_help: Auto: as many channels as this PC's sound output. On the computer: the sound stays on its speakers.
settings.mouse_help: Auto: the game mouse when a full-screen game hides the pointer. Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M switches between them during the session.
settings.keyboard_help: In full screen, Windows shortcuts (⊞ key, Alt+Tab) go to the computer. Ctrl+Alt+Del goes through the Keys menu of the session bar.
settings.transport_help: Fast suits your home network and gaming. Reliable resends what gets lost, at the cost of a little delay.
settings.reconnect_help: If the network drops during the session, the app reconnects on its own.
settings.wake_none: No address yet: connect to this computer once.
settings.wake_help: Turns the computer on remotely when it is asleep. It must also be allowed on the computer (Admin › System).

stats.help: The delay between the computer and this screen. Below a mark, the picture arrives before the next frame at that refresh rate.
stats.none: No session on this computer yet.

station.name: KyberNow Station
station.admin_help: Admin opens in your browser and asks for its password. The browser may warn about the certificate: the Station signs its own connection, this is expected.
station.restart_help: About 30 seconds. A session in progress will be cut off.
station.update_help: Version {version}. About a minute. A session in progress will be cut off.
station.requires_setup: Version {version} installs on the computer, with KyberNow-Station-Setup.exe.
station.too_soon: The Station has just restarted. Try again in a minute.
station.too_old: To restart or update the Station from this device, first update it from Admin.
station.offline: The computer is offline: the Station does not answer.
station.in_session_restart: Restarting the Station will end its session.
station.in_session_update: The update will end its session.
station.remove_confirm: Remove {name} from this device? You can add it again later.
station.slow_back: The Station is taking a while to come back. Open Admin to find out more.
station.update_failed: The update did not complete. Open Admin to find out more.

appsheet.help: Each version is verified before it installs: manifest signed by KyberNow, size and fingerprint of the installer. The app checks on its own at launch, then every 6 hours.
appsheet.probe_help: What this PC decodes, checked at launch by actually decoding a frame of each format. Profiles adjust to it on their own.
appsheet.battery_help: Save power: 30 Hz at most during sessions, with the bitrate lowered to match.

passage.slow: {name} is connected but not sending a picture. Its log often says why: in Admin, System › Logs.

bar.audio: Sound: {ms} ms to the output, {gaps} gaps filled this second

mock.not_a_link: this is not a kybernow:// link
mock.station_in_session: A device is connected (Apple TV du salon): restarting will end its session
